decisions.reason: The About page has no support-channel or Discord availability attribute, so the FAQ support-copy change does not alter its current content.
The Discord launch is already fully represented by the message-758 MODIFY adding the invitation link and removing the obsolete launch condition, together with the same-message RESUME.
The mission page's general community principles do not specify support channels and remain valid unchanged.
Discord and direct-support availability do not change the landing-page hero wording.
The support-channel update has no necessary effect on the hero layout or presentation constraints.
The Discord support update is unrelated to landing-page book-cover placement, sizing, cropping, or visibility.
The mechanics and prize copy contains no support-channel state affected by Discord becoming available.
The availability of a Discord support channel does not alter the mobile stacking or cutoff requirement.
The FAQ support-channel change has no effect on NFT metadata identity or attribute accuracy.
The direct-support email reference is incidental; Discord availability does not change the deferred Transak mint flow.
The support-channel update does not change automatic prize transfers or the Winners-page announcement requirement.
Discord availability does not change referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or payout behavior.
